messages.content: collab korte chai onno creator der sathe, kivabe approach korbo
Prothome dekho kader sathe collab tomar audience er jonno actual value add korবে, sudhu big follower thakle e hobe na.
ekjon pai j mone hoy thik audience match, message korbo kivabe
Short ar specific message pathao - kon idea ta niye collab korte chao, ki value dujon er jonno hote pare, eta clearly likho. Vague "let's collab sometime" message usually ignore hoy.
reply na dile ki abar follow up korbo?
Ekbar politely follow up kora thik ache 1-2 hopta por, kintu tarpor push kora uchit na. No response o ekta answer, move on koro other option er dike.
